title: Psalm 100: Enter His Gates with Thanksgiving
summary: In five verses the whole earth is called to shout to the LORD, serve him gladly, and come before him with singing. The reason is that the LORD is God, he made us, and we are his people and the sheep of his pasture. Worshipers are invited through the temple gates with thanks and praise, because the LORD is good, his loving devotion endures forever, and his faithfulness lasts through every generation.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: Songs of praise, or hymns, praise God for who he is and what he has made (Psalms 8, 100, 104).

line: The whole earth is called to come before the LORD with singing and enter his gates with thanks, because he made us, we are his, and his loving devotion endures forever.
guide: Come into God's presence by the simple door of thanks: before you ask for anything, thank him for one thing, then another. Let verse 3 settle you on a hard day as much as an easy one: you belong to someone, and he is good.

stanzas.title: Come before him, for the LORD made us and we are his
Enter his gates, for the LORD is good and faithful

verses.t: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
